title: Engine Room Weekly Huddle — Carmen Li (scratchpad)
body:
Quick notes / prep for Fri huddle (30m). Purpose: fast alignment across serving runtime, infra, and console on outstanding incidents, canary rollout status, and short action list. Informal — I'll use this as the running log during the call.

Meeting info:
- When: Fri 2026-03-13 11:00-11:30 PT (30m)
- Where: #eng-serving Zoom + bridge channel
- Attendees (ask to confirm): Diego A, Mikael J, Noelle P, Carmen L (me), optional: SRE buddy, Console PM

Goals for this week:
1) Validate canary for model-quant-2 (latency vs baseline) and decide go/no-go for broader rollout.
2) Surface infra capacity pressure for east-us region and agree on short-term mitigations.
3) Quick sync on console telemetry gap for token-level breakdown (broken chart follow-up).

Pre-reads (skim):
- PR: serving-runtime#487 (quantization fallback change) — main change + perf numbers (Diego)
- Grafana: "prod-serving/latency-30d" dashboard (last 48h focus)
- JIRA INF-1032: east-us autoscale edge-case notes

Agenda (timeboxed):
(0-3m) Quick status + 1-sentence blockers from each attendee
(3-12m) Canary check: quant-2 metrics (p50/p95/p99 token latency + error rate). Who speaks: Diego (perf owner)
(12-18m) Infra pressure: east-us instance churn, queue backlog, suggestions for micro-scaling or short-term burst capacity (SRE input)
(18-24m) Console telemetry: missing token-level series for route /v1/generate — quick troubleshooting plan (owner: Noelle)
(24-28m) Action items review + owners
(28-30m) Parking lot: any blockers for next week + quick sync time confirm

Notes to self (things to call out):
- Bring up the regression signal spotted yesterday at 03:40 UTC — small p99 spike correlated with GPU context switch logs (stacktrace snippet: local kv cache flush)
- Ask Diego whether the quant fallback doubles memory temporarily (I saw pods OOM-killed on canary two nights ago)
- Confirm whether console telemetry missing datapoints are behind our ingestion lambda (Noelle thought so)

Metrics snapshot (copy into doc during call):
- Canary (quant-2) p50: 12ms (+1ms vs baseline), p95: 48ms (+4ms), p99: 120ms (+18ms), error rate 0.03% (stable)
- Prod baseline p99 last 24h: 102ms
- East-us queue depth spike: from 45 -> 180 (peak) during 02:10–02:40 PT; avg worker CPU 78%

Decision prompts (pre-draft):
- If p99 delta > 15ms for quant-2, hold rollout and investigate kernel paths. Otherwise continue to staged rollout and monitor 24h.
- If east-us queue > 150 for >15m, trigger temporary +20% burst capacity and flip routing to west-us for new requests >= 1s latency

Action items (live table) — format: item | owner | due
- Capture full GPU OOM logs from canary node and attach to PR discussion | Diego Alvarez | 2026-03-14
- Add a metric to console ingestion pipeline for "tokens_ingested_by_route" and add alert if drop > 5% | Noelle Park | 2026-03-16
- Deploy short-lived extra worker pool in east-us (3 nodes) and monitor queue/backpressure for 2 hrs | SRE oncall (assign: Priya) | 2026-03-13 EOD
- Add canary traffic ramp plan to PR description (explicit % by time window) | Carmen Li | 2026-03-13
- Run a quick fuzz test for kv-cache flush under high-concurrency to reproduce p99 spike | Mikael Jensen | 2026-03-15

Parking lot / follow-up (not for this meeting unless time):
- Re-evaluate autoscaler thresholds for short-lived bursts (longer discussion, invite infra-autoscale owner)
- Retro on recent token-cost regression: collect baseline prompts and compare delta across quant variants
- Console: proposal to surface per-route cost in top-left of route page (low priority)

Questions I want answered during sync:
- Diego: can you reproduce OOM locally with the same CUDA driver version? If yes, ask to file small repro steps in PR.
- Noelle: confirm whether ingestion lambda shows retries (if yes then we have upstream loss).
- SRE: do we have spare capacity in west-us that can absorb 10% of steady QPS with no warmup?

Post-meeting follow-up template (copy into Slack thread):
- TL;DR decisions + concise action list with owners + links to artifacts. Tag relevant channels: #eng-serving, #sre, #console-product

Draft Slack blurb (short):
"Quick update from Engine Room huddle: holding canary if p99 > 15ms; east-us burst pool deployed; console ingestion metric added to backlog. Full notes + action items in thread. Ping owners for updates."

Handy links to paste during meeting: 
- Canary PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/487
- Grafana prod: https://grafana.redwood/d/serving/prod-serving-latency
- JIRA INF-1032: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1032

TODOs (personal):
- Print out short numbers before meeting to avoid reading dashboards live (fast handoff)
- Remind Priya about east-us deploy and ask SRE to post logs in thread
- After meeting: update PR with final decision and next steps

Random scribbles / possible phrasing for meeting notes: 
- "Canary looks close to baseline on p50/95; p99 shows edge-case when kv-cache flush and kernel fallback pair up — hold until OOM investigation complete"
- "Temporary east-us capacity added; monitor for 2h and decide whether to scale more or shift routing"

End of scratchpad. Will convert to formal meeting notes and post GH comment + Slack thread after call.
